Clocks.Title: Tension clocks
Clocks.Name: Clock name
Clocks.StepHint: Click to fill one segment, right-click to clear one
Clocks.Empty: No clocks yet. Add one for a chase, a ritual, guards arriving…
Clocks.Help: A clock is a progress bar for anything that should not be settled with one roll: escaping a forest, a chase, a ritual, guards on their way, a trial. Pick the number of segments by how hard or how long it is.
Clocks.HowTo: Fill a segment each time the characters make progress, or each time time passes or they fail. When the clock is full, it happens. Telling the players that a clock moved builds tension: use “Show in chat”. A full clock is a good moment for a curse.

Spotlight.Title: Spotlight & Stakes
Spotlight.NewSessionHint: Everyone moves back one moment, so last session's stars can wait
Spotlight.Stakes: Stakes: what this character cares about
Spotlight.AddStake: Patron, rival, fear… then Enter (Esc: cancel)
Spotlight.Empty: No player characters found. Add names above or drop actors here.
Spotlight.Help: Players care most about their own character. This list helps you share the spotlight: mark a pip when a character gets a moment of their own. Characters with fewer marks come first, so you can see at a glance who has been quiet.
Spotlight.HowTo: Press “New session” at the start of each session: every character loses one mark. Someone who had two moments last time keeps one, so others come first this time, but nobody starts from zero by accident.
Spotlight.StakesHelp: Stakes (⚓) are a few keywords about what matters to each character: a demanding patron, a rival, a fear, a crush, a slowly growing curse. When someone needs a moment, or when you need a twist, pick one of their stakes. A character with no stakes may need a chat with their player.
